نتكوفد (form IIq)
# نَتَكَوْفَدُ (natakawfadu) /na.ta.kaw.fa.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَوْفَدَ (takawfada)
# نَتَكَوْفَدَ (natakawfada) /na.ta.kaw.fa.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَوْفَدَ (takawfada)
# نَتَكَوْفَدْ (natakawfad) /na.ta.kaw.fad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَوْفَدَ (takawfada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
